DeepRead Fixture Document

DeepRead is a retrieval-augmented generation application. Users bring their
own sources — web pages or uploaded files — and the app answers questions
grounded only in that material.

Ingestion has two entry points. URL ingestion fetches a web page, strips
navigation and script tags, and extracts the remaining text. File ingestion
parses PDF, DOCX, TXT, or Markdown uploads directly.

After ingestion, the cleaned text is split into overlapping chunks. Each
chunk is embedded and stored in a session-scoped ChromaDB collection, keyed
by a UUID so that one user's sources are never visible to another user.

At query time, the question is embedded with the same model, the vector
store returns the most similar chunks, and those chunks are passed to the
language model as labeled context. The model is instructed to answer only
from that context and to cite which source it used.
